caption: The drawing features a symmetrical object composed of two elongated, brown sections joined together at the top by two grayish metal bands. Each section is decorated with intricate patterns of small white or silver bead-like dots arranged in geometric and linear designs. The left section has three horizontal bands of dots, with the lower end displaying a pattern of three triangular shapes filled with denser dot arrangements and a dangling tassel made of tightly grouped beads, ending in a conical pompom-like cluster. The right section has a series of scalloped rows of dots forming a net-like appearance, with the lowest portion featuring an extended mesh of white or silver beads forming a triangular fringe. Both sections hang down vertically against a plain, off-white background with minor spots and marks.
title: Bag
